name: RSI EA
summary: This EA trades based on RSI overbought and oversold levels, entering buy positions when RSI crosses below the oversold threshold and sell positions when RSI crosses above the overbought threshold. It is a classic momentum-reversal strategy that seeks to capture price corrections from extreme RSI readings. The EA typically includes configurable RSI period, overbought/oversold levels, and basic risk management parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖水平进行交易，当RSI下穿超卖阈值时买入，当RSI上穿超买阈值时卖出。这是一种经典的动量反转策略，旨在捕捉价格从RSI极端读数中的修正回调。EA通常包含可配置的RSI周期、超买超卖水平和基本的风险管理参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用RSI指标作为核心交易信号源，策略概念基于均值回归与动量衰竭的原理。入场条件为：当RSI从超卖区域（默认70以上）向下穿越时开仓卖出，当RSI从超买区域（默认30以下）向上穿越时开仓买入。出场条件通常依赖止盈止损参数，或RSI回到中性区域时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA一般采用固定手数交易，缺乏动态仓位调整机制如ATR或账户权益比例计算。资金管理较为基础，依赖用户手动设置合理的止损止盈比例，缺乏复合仓位或风险比例控制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但在趋势行情中容易产生连续亏损，需要配合趋势过滤器来提升稳定性。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the RSI indicator as its core trading signal source, with the strategy concept based on mean reversion and momentum exhaustion principles. Entry conditions: open a buy position when RSI crosses upward from the oversold zone (default below 30), and open a sell position when RSI crosses downward from the overbought zone (default above 70). Exit conditions typically rely on take-profit and stop-loss parameters, or closing positions when RSI returns to neutral territory. Position sizing is generally fixed lot-based, lacking dynamic sizing mechanisms such as ATR-based or account equity percentage calculations. Money management is relatively basic, relying on the user to manually set reasonable stop-loss and take-profit ratios, without proportional risk control or compounding position sizing. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, but it can easily produce consecutive losses during trending markets, requiring a trend filter to improve stability.

parameters.name: Overbought_Level
parameters.description: 超买阈值，RSI高于此值考虑卖出
parameters.description_en: Overbought threshold, consider sell when RSI exceeds this

parameters.name: Oversold_Level
parameters.description: 超卖阈值，RSI低于此值考虑买入
parameters.description_en: Oversold threshold, consider buy when RSI falls below this

parameters.name: Stop_Loss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: Take_Profit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和调试
RSI是经过长期验证的经典动量指标，在震荡市中表现良好
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和时间框架灵活调整超买超卖阈值
入场信号基于极端读数，具有一定的统计学优势
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and debug
RSI is a well-validated classic momentum indicator that performs well in ranging markets
Highly configurable parameters allow users to flexibly adjust overbought/oversold levels for different instruments and timeframes
Entry signals based on extreme readings provide a certain statistical edge
cons: 在强趋势行情中容易产生连续逆势交易导致严重亏损
缺乏趋势过滤器，无法区分震荡市和趋势市
固定手数交易缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动调整风险敞口
止盈止损设置可能不够灵活，0值默认存在极大风险
cons_en: Prone to consecutive counter-trend trades resulting in significant losses during strong trending markets
Lacks a trend filter, unable to distinguish between ranging and trending market conditions
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Stop-loss and take-profit settings may not be flexible enough, and the default value of 0 poses extreme risk
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX），仅在震荡市中交易RSI信号
实现基于ATR或账户权益比例的动态仓位管理
增加多时间框架确认机制，提高信号可靠性
添加传播过滤器避免高点差时段交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX) to only trade RSI signals in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account equity percentage
Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism to improve signal reliability
Add a spread filter to avoid trading during high-spread periods

risk_points: 止盈止损默认值可能为0，存在无限亏损风险
缺乏趋势过滤器，强趋势行情中可能连续逆势开仓
无点差过滤机制，高点差时交易成本侵蚀利润
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit values may be 0, presenting unlimited loss risk
Lacks trend filter, may consecutively open counter-trend positions during strong trends
No spread filter mechanism, high spread can erode profits through trading costs
